Supply a `components` list with one entry per REAL component the user described (2, 3, 5, however many); DocTemplateEngine clones the template row once per entry and discards the original. Never pad the list with an invented entry to hit some expected count, and never merge two real components into one to reduce the count - REQ-083-02 forbids inventing OR collapsing data either way.
